synth.notes:
Lattice 21x21 of 3x3 blocks; h-axis row ax (A1/A2), v-axis col ay (A3/A4), A5 cycles h->v->pieces(bbox order)->h; selected piece moves 1 block within board.
Piece blocks mirror across v-axis to solid gray reflections (not onto pieces); h and diagonal mirrors hidden; a piece with a cell on the h-row makes its whole v-mirror hidden (step-268 repair).
Hidden cells erase walls and mask targets; masked target shows only centre; target drawn on top; unselected piece hole passes wall 0-dot through.
Names: wall/piece index = rank + #0 pixels of other types before bbox; reflection index = rank among visible comps + hidden-cell comps; targets merge by bbox gap<=3.
Wall A1 mixed outcome = whether hidden mirror cells / pieces occlude that wall segment, not a wall field. Passes 45/45 stateless too; piece cycle order beyond 2 pieces unconfirmed.
